name: skyship_buccaneer_raid_draws_after_attack
notes: Pff857a4224 G4. Printed: 'Raid - When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.' Seat 0 attacks with a 2/2 Bear (seat 1 takes 2), then casts Skyship Buccaneer ({3}{U}{U}) in its postcombat main phase: the trigger draws exactly one card (hand 1 -> 0 on the cast -> 1), so the library keeps five.
